title: Carry code query param from home to join screen
description: If a user lands on the home page with a code query param, e.g. /?code=abc, the app should preserve that room code when they tap Join Room and prepopulate the Join Room code input.
acceptance_criteria: Opening /?code=abc shows the home screen; tapping Join Room navigates to the join screen with abc prefilled; /?screen=join&code=abc continues to work; /?screen=join&room=abc continues to work.

title: Randomize starting player each round
description: The player who starts speaking in the turns phase should be random for each round/game instead of always following the same room join order from the first player. This keeps the game fair and less predictable.
acceptance_criteria: When a round starts, the first currentTurnId is randomly selected from the players in the room; the turn order then proceeds through all players exactly once from that randomized starting point or a shuffled order; repeated rounds can start with different players; all clients see the same turn order/current player; existing refresh/resume behavior still restores the correct current turn.

title: Allow host to remove players from room
description: Hosts should be able to remove/kick a player from the room, especially from the lobby when someone joins by mistake, duplicates their session, or becomes disruptive/offline. The UI should expose a host-only remove action next to non-host players and the backend should remove that player from room state and notify clients.
acceptance_criteria: In the lobby, the host sees a remove/kick control for each non-host player; non-host users do not see remove controls; clicking remove asks for confirmation; confirmed removal deletes the player from the room player list and turn order; removed player's connected client is returned to the home/join flow or shown a clear removed message; host cannot remove themselves via this control; game state remains consistent after removal.

title: Support code query param on join screen
description: When visiting the app with a join URL, the room code input should be prepopulated from a code query argument. Example: http://54.196.177.53/?screen=join&code=abc should render the Join Room screen with abc already filled in. This should work alongside the existing room query param/session URL handling.
acceptance_criteria: Opening /?screen=join&code=abc shows the Join Room screen; the room code input contains ABC/abc; joining uses that value without retyping; existing /?screen=join&room=abc behavior still works; refresh does not clear the prefilled code.
